sections.title: Form and leaves
sections.text: Plantago lanceolata, ribwort plantain, is a perennial rosette herb. Its narrow, strongly veined leaves are usually 2–45 cm long; the erect flower stalks range from about 10 to 80 cm and may reach 120 cm.

sections.title: Flowers and seeds
sections.text: Dense cylindrical flower spikes are about 0.5–5 cm long, occasionally longer. Each capsule usually contains two seeds.

sections.title: Food
sections.text: Young leaves are used as a leafy vegetable. NatureScot describes them as usable in the same way as greater plantain, P. major.
